name: Out of Puberty: Chapter 1
source:
Young and beautiful Pearl has finished her school and has decided to move out of her parents' safety into her own place. Well not really her own... Her uncle owns multiple houses and apartments, and offers Pearl to stay in one of them for a price, a beautiful young women like Pearl can afford... or so she thinks.

Meet different characters all having a part in Pearl's life and find out how they will affect her. Be part of her day-to-day struggles and enjoy a story full of corruption, love, friendship and LUST!

[Edited from [url=https://fluffysan-sensei.itch.io/out-of-puberty-chapter-1]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
年輕美麗的珀爾已經畢業，決定離開父母的庇護，搬進自己的住處。好吧，也不完全屬於她……叔叔名下有好幾棟房子和公寓，願意讓珀爾住進其中一處，條件是付出一個像她這樣年輕漂亮的女人能夠承受的代價……至少，她是這麼想的。

結識在珀爾人生中扮演不同角色的人物，看看他們會給她帶來怎樣的影響。參與她日常生活中的掙扎，體驗一個充滿墮落、愛情、友誼與慾望的故事！

[編譯自[url=https://fluffysan-sensei.itch.io/out-of-puberty-chapter-1]Itch.io[/url]]
